articles.title: Tragedy at Faridabad Gym: 37-Year-Old Collapses, Dies During Workout
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Faridabad, Haryana — A 37-year-old man, Pankaj Sharma, died of a heart attack while working out at a gym in Ballabhgarh’s Sector 9 on Tuesday morning. Weighing around 170 kg, Pankaj collapsed while attempting shoulder pull-ups.

body.html:
Faridabad, Haryana — A 37-year-old man, Pankaj Sharma, died of a heart attack while working out at a gym in Ballabhgarh’s Sector 9 on Tuesday morning.

Weighing around 170 kg, Pankaj collapsed while attempting shoulder pull-ups. Despite immediate CPR and medical help, he could not be revived.

Pankaj, who had been regularly exercising for four months to lose weight, is survived by his wife and 2.5-year-old daughter. Police are investigating the incident and have collected CCTV footage from the gym.

articles.title: Horror in Hapur: 4 Kids, 1 Adult Crushed to Death by Speeding Truck — Driver on the Run!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur, UP — Five people, including four minors, were killed on Wednesday night when a speeding truck rammed into their motorcycle near Miniland School on Bulandshahr Road.

body.html:
Hapur, UP — Five people, including four minors, were killed on Wednesday night when a speeding truck rammed into their motorcycle near Miniland School on Bulandshahr Road.

Police said Danish (40) of Rafiqnagar was returning from a swimming pool with his two children and two nephews, all aged 8–11, when the truck hit them, killing all on the spot.

The truck driver fled the scene, leaving the vehicle behind, which has been impounded. The bodies have been sent for post-mortem, and a manhunt is underway.

body.html:
Goa–Pune SpiceJet flight SG1080 faced a mid-air scare on July 1, 2025, after a cosmetic interior window frame came loose, alarming passengers. The non-structural plastic trim and shutter detached, exposing insulation material, though the main outer window pane remained intact.

There was no impact on cabin pressurisation or passenger safety. The issue was fixed after landing in Pune as per maintenance protocol. While technically safe, the incident triggered panic onboard, with videos going viral online.

SpiceJet confirmed the event involved only a cosmetic fitting, not the structural window.

articles.title: Daylight Horror in Rajasthan: Woman Teacher Hacked to Death with Sword by Ex-Lover at Bus Stand
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Banswara, Rajasthan – In a chilling incident, 36-year-old government school teacher Leela Tabiyar was brutally murdered in broad daylight by her former lover at the Kalinjara bus stand on Tuesday (01 July 2025) morning.

body.html:
Banswara, Rajasthan – In a chilling incident, 36-year-old government school teacher Leela Tabiyar was brutally murdered in broad daylight by her former lover at the Kalinjara bus stand on Tuesday (01 July 2025) morning.

The accused, Mahipal Bhagora, arrived in an Alto car and attacked Leela with a sword, stabbing her in the abdomen without any altercation. He then tried to flee but crashed his car into a tree and escaped on foot.

Police rushed to the scene and shifted the victim to the district hospital, where she was declared dead. CCTV footage captured the entire crime. A manhunt has been launched, with checkpoints set up across the district.

Police suspect more than one attacker may have been involved. Investigation is underway.

articles.title: BJP Leader Beats Woman and Her Son With Slipper in Public – Viral Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Greater Noida – A shocking video has gone viral showing BJP leader Ateeq Pathan allegedly thrashing a woman and her son with a slipper and stick in the middle of the road in Bilaspur town of Dankaur area.

body.html:
Greater Noida – A shocking video has gone viral showing BJP leader Ateeq Pathan allegedly thrashing a woman and her son with a slipper and stick in the middle of the road in Bilaspur town of Dankaur area. The incident took place on June 30 and has triggered massive outrage on social media.

The woman, Sakina from Assam, has been living in Bilaspur for 15 years and works as a daily wage labourer. The dispute reportedly began over the installation of electric wires. When Sakina's son, Safikurrahman, tried to intervene during an argument with a neighbour, BJP’s Kasna Mandal Minister Ateeq Pathan allegedly beat him. When Sakina stepped in to protect her son, she too was assaulted.

The entire incident was captured on video by a bystander. After the video went viral, police arrested Pathan under breach of peace charges but have not filed an FIR for assault. Public criticism has intensified, with political parties like the Aazad Samaj Party calling out the BJP for double standards on women’s safety.

BJP local leadership claims the matter has been "settled" between both parties. Meanwhile, the demand for stricter legal action and justice for Sakina continues to grow.

articles.title: Nursing Student Sandhya Chaudhary Murdered in Broad Daylight as Staff Watch Silently
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Narsinghpur, MP – In a chilling case that has stunned Madhya Pradesh, 19-year-old nursing student Sandhya Chaudhary was brutally murdered inside the emergency unit of Narsinghpur District Hospital on June 27, 2025.

body.html:
Narsinghpur, MP – In a chilling case that has stunned Madhya Pradesh, 19-year-old nursing student Sandhya Chaudhary was brutally murdered inside the emergency unit of Narsinghpur District Hospital on June 27, 2025. The attacker, her boyfriend Abhishek Koshti, slit her throat in full public view while hospital staff, security guards, and bystanders stood by and did nothing.

The attack occurred around 2:30 pm outside Room 22 of the trauma centre. CCTV footage and a bystander's video show Koshti slapping Sandhya, pinning her down, and slashing her throat with a knife—all while dozens watched. The horrifying act lasted nearly 10 minutes. A nurse who tried to intervene was threatened with death.

Despite being inside a hospital, no help was provided. Sandhya bled to death on the spot. Koshti fled after a failed suicide attempt but was arrested within the hour.

The two had known each other for over two years. Police said Koshti accused Sandhya of "cheating" and had planned the murder in advance.

The incident sparked massive outrage. Sandhya’s family blocked roads demanding justice. Hospital officials admitted to grave security lapses. Two guards were posted at the trauma centre but failed to stop the attacker.

The viral video has intensified public anger, raising urgent questions about safety in public institutions and the accountability of on-duty staff.

articles.title: Hapur Horror: Speeding Car Crashes Into Hotel, Kills Youth Celebrating Girlfriend’s Birthday
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur, UP – A tragic accident took place late Monday night when a speeding car lost control and rammed into Raja Ji Haveli Hotel along NH-9. CCTV footage of the horrifying crash has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
Hapur, UP – A tragic accident took place late Monday night when a speeding car lost control and rammed into Raja Ji Haveli Hotel along NH-9. CCTV footage of the horrifying crash has gone viral on social media.

Ajit, a resident of Bulandshahr who had come to celebrate his girlfriend’s birthday, died on the spot. Two others sustained serious injuries and were shifted from a government hospital to Devnandini Hospital in Hapur for further treatment.

Eyewitnesses said the vehicle was overspeeding before it veered off the road and crashed into the hotel. The driver fled the scene after the incident. Police are scanning CCTV footage to trace the absconding driver.

The accident has sparked public anger, with many demanding stricter traffic enforcement on the busy highway. Authorities have promised swift action and urged drivers to adhere to speed limits.
